company.name: Salesforce, Inc.
company.industry: Enterprise SaaS / CRM Software / Cloud Applications / Agentic AI (Agentforce)
company.primary_assets: Co-location data center equipment, office facilities, leasehold improvements, finance lease ROU assets, goodwill & acquired intangibles (Slack, Own, Spiff, Zoomin etc.)
company.coverage_note: Salesforce 财年于 1 月 31 日结束：FY2025 覆盖 2024-02-01 至 2025-01-31，与 FY2024 确认版（2023-02-01 至 2024-01-31）连续衔接，与自然年口径样本相差约 1 个月。审计报告签署日 2025-03-05（HTML L3698）。

financial_highlights.depreciation_note: Note 5 原文：'Depreciation and amortization expense totaled $1.0 billion, $1.1 billion and $903 million during fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively'（HTML L4358）——固定资产（含融资租赁 ROU）折旧摊销口径，取整为 1,000。注意：FY2025 该值由 $1.1B 降至 $1.0B，与 FY2024 确认版趋势（678→903→1,100 递增）相反。现金流量表合并口径 'Depreciation and amortization' 为 $3,477M（含收购无形资产摊销与经营租赁 ROU 摊销/减值，见 depreciation_and_amortization_cashflow_millions）。
financial_highlights.amortization_note: 利润表脚注 (1)（HTML L3698）：收购无形资产摊销计入 cost of revenues $750M + sales and marketing $901M = $1,651M（FY2025）。Note 8 原文（L4433）：'Amortization of intangible assets resulting from business combinations for fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023 was $1.6 billion, $1.9 billion and $2.0 billion, respectively'，口径差异源于报废净额。
financial_highlights.impairment_note: NA - FY2025 无单独列示的 PP&E 减值科目，全文无 goodwill/PP&E 减值确认披露。现金流量表 D&A 脚注 (1)（L3699-3701）仍注明其包含 'amortization and impairment of right-of-use assets'，未单独量化；重组附注 FY2025 非现金项目合计仅 $81M（其中办公空间 $75M），为租赁 ROU 冲销且规模较 FY2024（$445M/$418M）大幅收缩。另有战略投资减值及下调 $583M（非 PP&E，计入 losses on strategic investments）；Note 1 明确 'no impairments of costs to obtain revenue contracts for fiscal 2025 and 2024'（L3912）。
financial_highlights.restructuring_note: 利润表 Restructuring 行 FY2025 $461M（FY2024 $988M、FY2023 $828M，L3698）；Note 10 拆分（L4462）：workforce reduction $386M + office space reductions $75M，非现金项目合计 $81M。FY2025 新批准一轮以定向裁员为主的重组举措，预计 FY2026 基本完成（L4456-4460）。
financial_highlights.server_depreciation_pct_note: NA - 未按资产类别披露折旧构成；公司无自有大规模服务器/GPU 集群，computers, equipment and software 原值 $4,345M（FY2024 $4,209M，仅 +3.2%）。
financial_highlights.goodwill_note: Note 8 商誉滚动表（L4435）：FY2025 新增 Spiff $323M + Zoomin $284M + Own $1,812M + 其他 $244M，由 $48,620M 增至 $51,283M（占总资产 49.8%）。
financial_highlights.construction_in_progress_note: NA - Note 5 PPE 明细表（Land 293 / Buildings 492 / Computers,equipment and software 4,345 / Furniture 232 / Leasehold improvements 1,556，L4358）无在建工程单列项目，与 FY2024 一致。
financial_highlights.finance_lease_payments_note: 现金流量表融资活动 'Principal payments on financing obligations' FY2025 $603M（FY2024 $629M，L3698）。Note 6（L4361）：FY2025 融资租赁成本 = ROU 摊销 $303M + 利息 $28M；融资租赁负债总额 $678M，最低付款总额 $708M，其中 FY2026 到期 $352M；融资活动租赁现金流出 $380M。
financial_highlights.infrastructure_commitments_note: MD&A Contractual Obligations（L3364-3369）：与基础设施服务提供商等的可执行合同承诺总额约 $17.3B，其中 $2.8B 未来 12 个月内到期——AI 时代算力需求主要通过向供应商购买服务（租用）满足，而非自建资产。
financial_highlights.useful_life_change_note: NA - FY2025 10-K 全文（去标签纯文本 4,927 行）'prospectively'、'change in estimate'、'change in accounting estimate' 均为 0 命中，本期未发生折旧年限估计变更，与 FY2024 确认版结论一致。

accounting_policy.policy_risk_note: 折旧政策与 FY2024 确认版逐字一致：计算机设备/软件 3-5 年直线法（Note 1，L4009-4010），本期无任何年限延长或缩短。Agentforce（agentic AI 层）于 FY2025 全面推出，但 10-K 未披露任何自有 GPU 集群建设或基础设施策略转向：PPE 净值由 $3,689M 降至 $3,236M（-12.3%），capex 由 $736M 降至 $658M（-10.6%），固定资产折旧摊销由 $1.1B 降至 $1.0B，AI 算力缺口通过 $17.3B 基础设施服务提供商承诺（租用）填补。轻资产负样本特征在 AI 产品化后依然成立；资产负债表最大估计依赖项仍是商誉 $51.3B（占总资产 49.8%）。

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 1. Summary of Business and Significant Accounting Policies
risk_signals.text_excerpt: Depreciation is calculated on a straight-line basis over the estimated useful lives of those assets as follows: Buildings and building improvements 10 to 40 years; Computers, equipment and software 3 to 5 years; Furniture and fixtures 5 years; Leasehold improvements Shorter of the estimated lease term or 10 years. The Company estimates the useful lives of property and equipment upon initial recognition and periodically evaluates the useful lives and whether events or changes in circumstances warrant a revision to the useful lives.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: 官方折旧年限表与 FY2024 确认版完全一致：计算机设备/软件 3-5 年，介于技术迭代周期（1-2 年）与 GOOGL 变更后 6 年之间，错配比约 1.5-5 倍。资产基数继续缩小：PPE 总值 $6,918M、净值 $3,236M，仅占总资产 $102,928M 的 3.1%（FY2024 为 3.7%）——年限假设偏差的利润杠杆进一步收窄。
evidence_chain: 官方披露：computers, equipment and software 折旧 3-5 年（直线法），与 FY2024 逐字一致
技术迭代周期约 1-2 年，年限错配 1.5-5 倍（锚点档位不变）
PPE 净值 $3,236M 仅占总资产 3.1%，较 FY2024（3.7%）进一步下降
FY2025 固定资产折旧摊销 $1.0B 仅为收入的 2.6%（FY2024 为 3.2%）
Result: 年限档位不变、基数缩小，D1 锚点维持 3 分

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 10. Restructuring
risk_signals.keyword_matched: restructuring initiatives / workforce reduction / office space reductions
risk_signals.text_excerpt: In fiscal 2025, the Company approved restructuring initiatives focused on driving further operational efficiencies, optimizing our management structure and increasing cost optimization efforts to realize long-term sustainable growth through a targeted workforce reduction, which are expected to be substantially complete in fiscal 2026. ... Charges: Workforce Reduction $386 / Office Space Reductions $75 / Total $461 (fiscal 2025); Non-cash items: $(81) fiscal 2025.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 10. Restructuring (HTML lines 4448-4463); corroborated in MD&A (line 3210-3214) and income statement (line 3698)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: FY2025 重组费用 $461M，较 FY2024（$988M）下降 53%；其中与资产相关的办公空间削减仅 $75M（非现金 $75M，为租赁 ROU 冲销），较 FY2024 的 $447M/$418M 大幅收缩，且新一轮重组以定向裁员为主（$386M）。资产冲销类重组风险正在出清而非累积，且仍完全不涉及计算设备。
evidence_chain: 非现金项目 $81M（FY2024 $445M）——租赁 ROU 冲销规模显著下降
对象仍为办公/租赁资产，computers, equipment and software 零减值
MD&A 明确 'We do not expect to incur significant additional charges in connection with our restructuring initiatives in the near term'（L3212-3214）
Result: 实际资产冲销规模收缩，D3 维持锚点 2 分（稀少且远离核心资产类别）

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 1. Impairment Assessment / Goodwill
risk_signals.keyword_matched: impairment whenever events or changes in circumstances / undiscounted cash flows
risk_signals.text_excerpt: The Company evaluates intangible assets and other long-lived assets for possible impairment whenever events or changes in circumstances indicate that the carrying amount of such assets may not be recoverable... Recoverability of these assets is measured by comparing the carrying amount of each asset group to the future undiscounted cash flows the asset is expected to generate... The Company evaluates and tests the recoverability of its goodwill for impairment annually during its fourth quarter of each fiscal year or more often if and when circumstances indicate that goodwill may not be recoverable.
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: 标准 US GAAP 减值框架，与 FY2024 确认版一致：长期资产以未折现现金流做可回收性测试（低门槛），商誉年度 Q4 测试。FY2025 未披露任何商誉或 PP&E 减值确认。主要估计依赖敞口仍在商誉 $51,283M（总资产 49.8%，因 Own/Spiff/Zoomin 收购较 FY2024 增加 $2.7B）而非固定资产。
evidence_chain: 减值测试门槛为未折现现金流（宽松），政策文本与 FY2024 一致
FY2025 无商誉/PP&E 减值确认披露；Note 1 另明确合同取得成本零减值（L3912）
商誉 $51,283M 占总资产近半且 FY2025 继续增加（+5.5%），年度测试依赖预测假设
Result: 减值政策信号存在，但仍指向商誉/无形资产而非折旧算法的目标资产

risk_signals.keyword_matched: cloud computing platform partners / third-party data center facilities / co-location lease / Hyperforce
risk_signals.text_excerpt: We provide our services through cloud computing platform partners who offer Infrastructure-as-a-Service, including servers, storage, databases and networking, as well as through infrastructure designed and operated by us but secured within third-party data center facilities. We continue to invest and expand the deployment of Hyperforce, which allows our platform and applications to be delivered rapidly and reliably to locations worldwide and provides our customers autonomy and control over data residency. ... We operate data centers in the U.S., Europe and Asia pursuant to various co-location lease arrangements.
risk_signals.page_location: Item 1. Business - Infrastructure (HTML lines 443-450); Item 2. Properties (line 2532)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: 负样本结构性证据在 Agentforce 财年依然成立，且表述顺序较 FY2024 更突出租用优先（'cloud computing platform partners' 置于自有托管之前）。公司拥有的是设备（3-5 年折旧）+ 融资租赁 ROU（净值 $812M），不拥有数据中心建筑与土地的重资产敞口；Hyperforce 持续扩张部署意味着进一步向公有云迁移。
evidence_chain: 基础设施模式：公有云 IaaS 合作伙伴 + 自有设备托管于第三方机房（co-location）
明确趋势：'continue to invest and expand the deployment of Hyperforce'（向公有云平台进一步迁移）
CAPEX $658M = 收入的 1.7%（FY2024 2.1%），vs META 20%+ / GOOGL 10%+
无自有 GPU 集群、无在建工程单列披露，PPE 净值同比下降 12.3%
Result: AI 算力迭代风险仍由供应商承担，公司自身折旧敞口结构性极低且继续收窄

risk_signals.source: Item 1A. Risk Factors - Service Disruptions / Infrastructure Capacity
risk_signals.keyword_matched: deployment of AI technologies / infrastructure capacity requirements / computing power / continue to move to cloud computing platform providers
risk_signals.text_excerpt: As we scale our operations, the amount and type of information transferred on our offerings continues to evolve, including as a result of the deployment of AI technologies, and our infrastructure capacity requirements, including network capacity and computing power, may increase as a result. If we do not accurately plan for our infrastructure capacity requirements and we experience significant strains on our data center capacity, our customers could experience performance degradation or service outages... As we add data centers and capacity and continue to move to cloud computing platform providers, we move or transfer our data and our customers' data from time to time.
risk_signals.page_location: Item 1A. Risk Factors - Service Disruptions (HTML lines 929-943)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: 这是 FY2025 相对 FY2024 最重要的增量表述：公司首次在风险因素中明确将 AI 技术部署与基础设施容量/算力需求增长挂钩（Agentforce 时代的直接承认）。但应对路径仍是 'continue to move to cloud computing platform providers'——容量风险指向上限不足（服务中断），而非自有资产过剩/过时，与 META/GOOGL 的自有算力折旧风险方向相反。
evidence_chain: 管理层自认 AI 部署推高 'infrastructure capacity requirements, including network capacity and computing power'
风险形态为容量不足→服务降级，而非资产过时→减值
应对策略：增加数据中心与容量 + 继续迁往云计算平台提供商（租用）
对应财务证据：capex 反降 10.6%，$17.3B 承诺付给基础设施服务提供商（SIG-009）
Result: AI 算力需求上升属实，但资产负债表暴露仍被结构性转移，D5 维持 1 分

risk_signals.source: Item 1A. Risk Factors - Acquisitions; Note 8. Intangible Assets and Goodwill

risk_signals.page_location: Item 1A. Risk Factors - Risks related to acquisitions (HTML lines 985-989); Note 8 (HTML lines 4433-4435)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: Risk Factors 中唯一直接提及 depreciation/amortization 影响利润的条目，与 FY2024 确认版一致，仍指向收购无形资产摊销（FY2025 $1,651M）而非固定资产折旧。FY2025 新增 Own（商誉 $1,812M）、Spiff、Zoomin 三笔收购，商誉增至 $51.3B；Note 8 显示收购技术开发净值 $1,205M 的加权平均剩余摊销期仅 0.9 年（全部无形 2.8 年）——摊销节奏已快于技术寿命，不存在年限乐观问题。
evidence_chain: 风险因素自认：收购资产可能 write-off，收购无形/固定/ROU 资产摊销拖累利润
FY2025 收购无形资产摊销 $1,651M，是固定资产折旧（$1.0B）的 1.65 倍
Note 8：收购技术开发剩余摊销期 0.9 年（FY2024 为 2.2 年）——摊销已贴近甚至快于技术寿命
FY2025 三笔新收购（Own/Spiff/Zoomin）新增商誉约 $2.4B，商誉敞口扩大至 $51.3B
Result: '类折旧'风险继续集中在并购会计端，且摊销假设偏保守而非乐观

risk_signals.source: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements - Note 5. Property and Equipment, Net
risk_signals.keyword_matched: Depreciation and amortization expense totaled / Property and equipment, net
risk_signals.text_excerpt: Computers, equipment and software $4,345 (2025) vs $4,209 (2024); Property and equipment, gross 6,918 vs 6,841; Less accumulated depreciation and amortization (3,682) vs (3,152); Property and equipment, net $3,236 vs $3,689. Depreciation and amortization expense totaled $1.0 billion, $1.1 billion and $903 million during fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.
risk_signals.page_location: Note 5. Property and Equipment, Net and Other Balance Sheet Accounts (HTML line 4358)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: FY2025 最具区分度的定量证据：在 Agentforce 全面商业化、AI 算力需求自认上升（SIG-006）的同一财年，固定资产折旧摊销由 $1.1B 降至 $1.0B、PPE 净值下降 12.3%、capex 下降 10.6%——公司用'不持有资产'的方式响应 AI 军备竞赛。与 GOOGL/META'资产暴增+年限延长'的形态完全相反，是负样本干净性的最强单点证据。

computers, equipment and software 原值仅 +3.2%（$4,209M→$4,345M），无 GPU 采购潮痕迹
对照 FY2024 确认版 D4 关键指标，所有资产密集度指标同向下降
Result: 折旧假设偏差的杠杆效应进一步锁死，D4 维持锚点 1 分

risk_signals.keyword_matched: infrastructure service providers / total commitments $17.3 billion
risk_signals.text_excerpt: In addition to our leasing arrangements, we have other contractual commitments associated with agreements that are enforceable and legally binding, including those with infrastructure service providers. As of January 31, 2025 our total commitments under these agreements were approximately $17.3 billion, of which payments of $2.8 billion are due in the next 12 months and $14.5 billion are due thereafter.
risk_signals.page_location: Item 7. MD&A - Liquidity and Capital Resources - Contractual Obligations (HTML lines 3364-3369)
risk_signals.relevance_to_depreciation: FY2025 AI 基础设施策略的定量落点：$17.3B 承诺付给基础设施服务提供商（购买算力/托管服务），相当于 PPE 净值（$3,236M）的 5.3 倍。算力以 OPEX 化/承诺化的方式获得，硬件过时与残值风险由服务商承担；这与 Oracle（$32.2B 表外租赁承诺但自有 PP&E 快速扩张）形态不同——Salesforce 连自有设备扩张都没有。
evidence_chain: 对基础设施服务提供商的可执行合同承诺 $17.3B（$2.8B 一年内到期）
对比：PPE 净值仅 $3,236M，承诺额为其 5.3 倍
租赁承诺另计 $4.0B（其中 $3.3B 为设施场地，L4368）
管理层同时声明 'we may slow the pace of our investments'（L3376-3379），保留缩减弹性
Result: 算力风险转移模式获得定量确认，D5 锚点 1 分依据充分

dimension_scores.dimension_name: 折旧年限 vs 技术实际寿命
dimension_scores.dimension_name_en: Depreciation Life vs Technology Useful Life
dimension_scores.reasoning: 锚点对照 FY2024 确认版（D1=3）：计算机设备/软件折旧年限 3-5 年逐字未变（Note 1，L4009-4010），落在锚点 3-5 年档→3 分。错配比约 1.5-5 倍不变。资产基数进一步缩小（PPE 净值占总资产由 3.7% 降至 3.1%），但按既定口径基数效应在 D4 体现，D1 不因此下调——与 FY2024 确认版处理逻辑一致。

锚点对照 FY2024 确认版（D2=3）：全文 'prospectively'/'change in estimate'/'change in accounting estimate' 连续第二年 0 命中，本期无折旧年限变更→3 分。Agentforce 推出财年亦未跟进 GOOGL/MSFT 式年限延长；折旧摊销 $1.0B 与 PPE 原值微增（+1.1%）方向正常，无'资产增折旧降'异常。无真实政策变化→分数不变。

锚点对照 FY2024 确认版（D3=2）：本期资产相关冲销进一步收缩——重组中办公空间削减仅 $75M（非现金 $75M，FY2024 为 $447M/$418M）；战略投资减值及下调 $583M 仍为非 PP&E。无任何计算设备减值、无 PP&E/商誉减值确认、合同取得成本零减值。按锚点'仅间接/稀少→2 分'维持不变：实际冲销存在但规模缩小且远离折旧风险核心资产类别；大额减值敞口仍在商誉 $51.3B（并购会计问题）。
锚点对照 FY2024 确认版（D4=1）：CAPEX/收入 = $658M / $37,895M = 1.74%，落在锚点 <5% 档（→1 分），且较 FY2024（2.11%）进一步下降。固定资产折旧摊销 $1.0B 仅为收入的 2.6%；PPE 净值占总资产 3.1%；无在建工程单列披露；AI 放量年 capex 不升反降（-10.6%）。折旧假设偏差的杠杆效应在结构上被进一步锁死。

锚点对照 FY2024 确认版（D5=1）：任务特别关注的'Agentforce 是否改变基础设施策略'经文件事实检验为否——10-K 未披露任何自有 GPU 集群建设；风险因素自认 AI 部署推高算力需求（SIG-006），但应对路径是 'continue to move to cloud computing platform providers' + $17.3B 基础设施服务提供商承诺（SIG-009），且 capex/PPE 净值/折旧三指标同向下降（SIG-008）。AI 军备竞赛的算力迭代成本仍由供应商承担，按锚点'算力租用风险转移→1 分'维持。

key_metrics.agentforce_infra_strategy_change: none disclosed - AI agents delivered on existing platform via rented compute
key_metrics.infrastructure_model: co-location + public cloud platform partners (Hyperforce, expanding)
key_metrics.gpu_exposure: indirect - rented compute, obsolescence borne by infrastructure providers
key_metrics.competition_layer: application/agent layer (Agentforce), not compute asset layer

composite_score.confidence_reason: 与 FY2024 确认版（2.10）完全同分，反映文件事实：FY2025 无折旧政策变化、无 PP&E 减值、capex/折旧/PPE 三降。低风险结论四向互证：(1) 定量：CAPEX/收入 1.7%、PPE 占总资产 3.1%；(2) 定性：全文无年限变更、无 obsolescence 表述；(3) 结构性：$17.3B 租用算力承诺将迭代风险转移给供应商；(4) 趋势：Agentforce 放量年资产密集度指标全面下降。置信度略高于 FY2024（0.85→0.88），因连续两年数据排除了单年偶然性。加权计算：3×0.25 + 3×0.20 + 2×0.20 + 1×0.20 + 1×0.15 = 2.10。

same_company_baseline.anchor_consistency_conclusion: 五维分数与综合分逐项持平，符合军规'分数变化只反映真实政策/风险变化'：FY2025 10-K 未显示任何折旧政策或风险结构变化。任务特别核查的三点结论：(1) Agentforce AI 产品推出未改变基础设施策略——无自有 GPU 披露，Hyperforce（公有云部署）持续扩张，$17.3B 承诺付给基础设施服务提供商；(2) capex 仍极低且进一步下降至 $658M（收入的 1.7%，FY2024 为 2.1%）；(3) 无商誉/无形资产减值确认，重组费用 $988M→$461M 收缩且以裁员为主。真实变化均为'风险进一步走低'方向，但幅度不足以跨越锚点档位（D3 冲销 $447M→$75M 仍属'稀少'档；D4 已在最低档），故分数保持不变。

key_deltas_vs_fy2024.new_disclosure: AI deployment explicitly linked to infrastructure capacity requirements (Risk Factors, L929-939); $17.3B infrastructure service provider commitments

comparative_context.crm_positioning_note: CRM FY2025 综合 2.10（中风险偏低端），与 FY2024 确认版持平，维持全样本轻资产负样本锚点地位。Agentforce 商业化首年的文件证据强化了负样本有效性：公司在 AI 产品收入放量的同时固定资产指标全面收缩，为训练集提供了'AI 公司 ≠ 高折旧风险'的关键对照样本。

annotation_methodology.source_document: Salesforce, Inc. FY2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K (CIK 0001108524, document crm-20250131, fiscal year ended January 31, 2025, signed March 5, 2025)
annotation_methodology.text_extraction_method: Python HTML tag-stripping (regex + html.unescape, encoding errors='replace') into plain text with original line numbers + case-insensitive keyword search (useful life/useful lives, depreciation, impairment, obsolescence, prospectively, change in estimate, data center, restructuring, Agentforce, GPU, Hyperforce); every candidate hit verified in visible body text with HTML line numbers; hidden ix:hidden XBRL tag matches excluded
annotation_methodology.cross_year_anchor_procedure: FY2025 标注前先读取 FY2024 确认版 JSON（只读），逐项对照：折旧政策文本（逐字一致）、关键词扫描口径（同一脚本同一词表）、五维锚点档位定义、信号编号与 risk_type 命名规范；分数仅当文件事实显示真实政策/风险变化时才允许变动——本年无此类事实，故五维全平。
annotation_methodology.scoring_method: Five-dimension weighted scoring (D1 0.25 / D2 0.20 / D3 0.20 / D4 0.20 / D5 0.15), 1-5 integer scale per dimension, anchored to confirmed META 2023 benchmark (4.0), GOOGL 2023 draft (4.25), and same-company confirmed CRM FY2024 (2.10)
annotation_methodology.human_verification: All quoted text excerpts verified against original 10-K filing at cited HTML line numbers via tag-stripped extraction; 5 excerpts machine-verified verbatim (whitespace/punctuation-normalized substring match)
annotation_methodology.limitation: Single-year 10-K analysis. PP&E 折旧（$1.0B）与收购无形资产摊销（$1,651M）、经营租赁 ROU 摊销/减值在现金流量表合并列示（$3,477M），拆分为近似值；$17.3B 基础设施服务提供商承诺未按算力/其他细分；Salesforce 财年于 1 月 31 日结束，与自然年样本存在约 1 个月错位。
